purpose: Teach: 動脈/省令/偵察/定理/不合理/非行/射殺/勃発

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、動脈疾患の社会要因を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about the social determinants of cardiovascular disease in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant attention. Open invitation. Steady pace, genuine curiosity — the tone of a teacher who has actually read the work and wants to hear the student's own thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、省令改正の影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on how the regulatory amendments affected outcomes.
lines.style: Respectful but clear. Slight lift on the affirmative — she's ready to speak about her work. Direct eye contact. No hesitation, no over-explanation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の偵察活動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And I noticed you explored reconnaissance operations during wartime—
lines.style: Gentle pause after the dash, like she's checking herself. Thoughtful, not leading. She's about to point something out, but she's giving Sakura space to clarify first.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、数学の定理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my paper was on mathematical theorems and their proofs.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. Matter-of-fact. A small calm underlining of what she actually did. No frustration, just accuracy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の不合理な構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you looked at systemic irrationality in society—
lines.style: Following the thread again. Warm, interested. Leaning slightly forward in attention. Same gentle checking-pattern as before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、青少年の非行問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, that was actually about youth delinquency and its root causes.
lines.style: Patient second correction. Still calm, still direct. A tiny bit more weight to it this time — she's gently standing her ground about what her work actually contains.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 要人射殺事件の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And then there was the history of the assassination—
lines.style: Pausing again mid-thought. Softer now. There's something she's trying to understand. Reflective, like she's wondering what the pattern means.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、内戦勃発の背景を論文で扱いました
lines.en: That was about the background leading to civil conflict.
lines.style: Steady finish. She meets the teacher's gaze. There's a small breath before the answer — she understands now what the teacher is doing, what she's noticing. Calm and held.
